sections.usage:
## Usage

Live site: **[mafhper.github.io/aurawall](https://mafhper.github.io/aurawall)**

For local development:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mafhper/aurawall.git
cd aurawall
npm ci
npm run dev
```
sections.extra:
## Release policy

This project ships **no distribution artifact**. The site is a static build, and its build output is the deploy's business, not a release asset. GitHub already publishes the source archive of every tag natively, so a second copy would add nothing. The release carries the version, the notes and one editorial image.

**Release and deploy are separate.** A `vX.Y.Z` tag runs this protocol and produces the GitHub Release. A push to `main` runs the Pages deploy. They start from the same code and answer different questions — *"which version was produced and validated?"* versus *"what is currently published?"* The `npm run build` below is not redundant: it validates the exact commit the tag points at, which is not necessarily the last `main` that deployed.

**Image policy.** The release image is resolved per tag, from the most specific to the most generic — `release-vX.Y.Z.webp`, then the `major.minor` line `release-vX.Y.webp`. With `granularity: "minor"`, entering a new `major.minor` line requires a new image in that tag, and the workflow fails otherwise. To fix the image of a published tag, commit `release-vX.Y.Z-new.webp` to the default branch and re-run that tag's workflow: the tag is not moved, and the asset keeps the same canonical name.
